audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed with the why printed beside them: Level 1 marked Ziggs 3/10 under 'your range plus Harrier auto-reset out-trades his slow level-1 bomb', Level 2 marked Skill under 'W's attack-speed steroid makes your Harrier trades hurt more', Levels 4-5 and First item marked Quinn under whys that say 'you can no longer hard all-in him' and 'it stays a coin-flip', Level 6 marked Ziggs under 'even window', and 2+ items marked Quinn under 'he reclaims the lane'.
audit.why: 50.62% over 241 games and the packet chart is Quinn rows 0-2, Skill rows 3-5, Ziggs row 6 — which is exactly what the whys already describe.
audit.corrected: Quinn rows 0-2, Skill rows 3-5, Ziggs row 6, both layers.

audit.why: The spike ladder is unusually good here — it already pins his second spike to Ziggs level 9 (Bouncing Bomb maxed at 4s) rather than a generic item timing, and Mega Inferno Bomb at 5000 range on 120s rank 1 is correctly treated as siege rather than a lane duel button.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge is named on every panel but never quantified, and three interactions are absent: it deals percent maximum health (so MR does not answer it), its displacement cancels your Behind Enemy Lines channel, and Short Fuse is an auto reset whose cooldown shortens every time he casts an ability.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000 range with knockup and percentHealth flags; Quinn's R is an interruptible channel. Short Fuse's reset means his real burst is bomb-then-auto, so the ability cast is the cue to step back, not the auto wind-up on its own.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s maxed, percent max health, knocks you away and him clear, and cancels your R channel. Hexplosive Minefield: flat 16s, 900 range. Short Fuse: an auto reset that refreshes faster the more he casts.

audit.whatIsWrong: The last sentence of 'early' reads 'His blind matters less than usual here because you're the one with the burst auto, not him.' Ziggs has no blind in his kit.
audit.why: Nothing in Short Fuse, Bouncing Bomb, Satchel Charge, Hexplosive Minefield or Mega Inferno Bomb blinds. The sentence is boilerplate from a different matchup and confuses the reader about whose blind is whose.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the Short Fuse auto-reset tell.

audit.why: Satchel Charge 20s to 12s, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s at every rank, Bouncing Bomb 6s down to 4s — the flat 16s in particular is worth knowing, because unlike most abilities ranking it up buys him nothing in uptime.

edits.after: Your W steroid makes Harrier trades hurt more than one Bouncing Bomb can answer — step up and punish.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Satchel Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: Your first item roughly matches his first AP item — it stays a coin-flip walk-up, so pick your spots.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Ziggs carry threat 7.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He sieges from a screen away and Satchel Charge peels you off — you have no gap-closer, so close it earlier.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Satchel Charge knocks you straight back out — Vault after it, not before.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours if you play them right — his bombs are slow and you out-range his autos with Harrier resets. When he steps up to last-hit, throw Q to blind and chunk, then E-Vault in for the leap auto. Don't walk straight at him through his Q; wait for him to commit a bomb, then punish the cooldown. His blind matters less than usual here because you're the one with the burst auto, not him.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours if you play them right — his bombs are slow and you out-range his autos with Harrier resets. When he steps up to last-hit, throw Q to blind and chunk, then Vault in for the leap auto. Don't walk at him through Bouncing Bomb; wait for him to spend it, then punish the 6 seconds. Short Fuse is an auto reset that refreshes faster every time he casts, so the bomb-then-auto is the burst tell.

edits.before: By 4-5 his Q rank-ups start to sting and you can't all-in him forever — he just steps back and pokes. This is when you stop fighting the lane he wants and start using your map. At 6, R out and roam bot or mid; your kill threat elsewhere is worth more than eating bombs to force a fight he kites. Punish him hardest when his E minefield and W are on cooldown.
edits.after: By 4-5 Bouncing Bomb ranks down to 4 seconds and you can't all-in him forever — he steps back and pokes. Stop fighting the lane he wants and use your map instead. At 6, R out and roam; your kill threat elsewhere beats eating bombs to force a fight he kites. Punish hardest when Hexplosive Minefield (16s) and Satchel Charge are both down.

notes: Satchel Charge is flagged percentHealth, which is why the page's Mercury's Treads recommendation is right for the tenacity but wrong if a reader reads it as damage mitigation — resistances do not reduce that portion. I did not rewrite the item line, but report[8].t could usefully say so.
